answer: Bind the bond to a hardware root of trust, reset the whole standing on any attempt to link two identities through shared funding, and require a fresh nonce per submission so a captured answer cannot be replayed. That closes replay and the obvious wallet split, though a rented machine still passes the root check. The thread that holds is cost: one bond and one machine per identity, and the beacon stays lit only while none of them touch the same funding source, since the tide of standing is wiped the moment two do.
